packs.name: Core
packs.description: What makes Aeon different from a cron job: it coordinates a fleet of instances, self-configures its own workflows, and keeps itself alive.

skills.name: API Health
skills.description: Pre-batch API provider health check — detects credit exhaustion or auth failure for every configured provider key before the scheduled batch runs, giving the operator a window to act before skills degrade

skills.name: Auto Merge
skills.description: Automatically merge open PRs that have passing CI, no blocking reviews, and no conflicts

skills.name: Auto-Workflow Builder
skills.description: Two-mode aeon.yml workflow builder - analyze inspects URLs and emits a tiered, signal-verified skill-enablement plan plus an aeon.yml diff; enable flips slugs to enabled:true and opens a PR.

skills.name: batch-health
skills.description: Post-batch audit — checks whether all enabled scheduled skills fired in their expected window, alerts on silent misses, files issues on batch-level outages

skills.name: Config Validator
skills.description: Validate aeon.yml and .github/workflows/aeon.yml for structural invariants that have caused past outages — checkout step ordering, duplicate skill keys, missing skill files

skills.name: Contributor Leaderboard
skills.description: Ranking of developers contributing to the fork fleet and back upstream

skills.name: contributor-spotlight
skills.description: Recognition post for one fork operator — converts fork-cohort cohort data into a named human moment (POWER fork callout with their work, stars, and skills enabled)

skills.name: cost-report
skills.description: API cost report — computes dollar costs from token usage, flags anomalies, forecasts burn, and prescribes concrete optimizations

skills.name: Fleet Control
skills.description: Operate managed Aeon instances from memory/instances.json - health-check, dispatch, and status snapshots (control), plus a fleet scorecard of runs, tokens, cost, and reliability (scorecard).

skills.name: fleet-state
skills.description: Fleet-state digest — synthesises fork-cohort, contributor-spotlight, and fork-release into one "state of the fleet" narrative

skills.name: Followup Patrol
skills.description: Escalation audit — parses the follow-up / open-loop section of MEMORY.md plus the issue tracker, computes item ages, and alerts on items hitting urgency thresholds so nothing rots unattended

skills.name: fork-cohort
skills.description: Fork-activation cohort tracker — buckets every fork by recent run activity (COLD / STALE / ACTIVE / POWER) with deltas since the prior snapshot

skills.name: Fork Digest
skills.description: Cross-fork customization digest — surfaces where the fleet's enable/disable/var/model decisions diverge from upstream defaults

skills.name: Fork Firstrun
skills.description: Named alert when a fork completes its first ever workflow run — catches the activation moment that slower fork-cohort snapshots would miss

skills.name: fork-fleet
skills.description: Fork divergence monitor - tracks where the fleet's active forks diverge in CODE (unique commits, new/modified skills) and CONFIG (enable/var/model/schedule vs upstream), gated on real change.

skills.name: Fork Health
skills.description: Per-fork health tier synthesizing push recency + enabled skill count + 30d PR activity into ACTIVE/WARM/STALE/QUIET buckets; fleet health ratio + top-10 ACTIVE table; silent when nothing moves

skills.name: Fork Release
skills.description: Scan that celebrates when any fork of the parent repo cuts a tagged GitHub release. Silent when no fork releases in the window.

skills.name: Frequency Guard
skills.description: Per-skill run-count watchdog — checks if any capped skills exceeded their configured daily limit and alerts on breach

skills.name: Heartbeat
skills.description: Ambient fleet-health check that surfaces anything worth attention (default), or an on-demand priority brief - the 3 things to focus on, why now, and what moved (var=brief)

skills.name: Janitor
skills.description: Cleanup of accumulated temp files — .notify-* root-level files, .pending-notify-temp/, and stale .outputs/ chain artifacts older than their TTL

skills.name: Memory Dedupe
skills.description: Detect and collapse structural duplicate rows in MEMORY.md — sections like Recent Articles and Skills Built that accumulate multiple content blocks across memory-flush cycles. Companion to scripts/memory-dedupe (topic-pointer dedup); this handles section-level row accumulation and duplicate H2 headings (the same section heading appearing 2+ times in the file).

skills.name: Memory Flush
skills.description: Promote important recent log entries into MEMORY.md and prune stale ones

skills.name: narrative-convergence
skills.description: Cross-skill signal detector - finds entities or themes surfaced independently by 3+ different skill categories within 48h and surfaces them as high-confidence write opportunities

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: One-shot setup validator — runs every check from the ./onboard CLI inside the workflow and sends the resulting checklist to the configured notification channel

skills.name: Reflect
skills.description: Review recent activity, consolidate memory, and prune stale entries

skills.name: Retrospective
skills.description: KALM retrospective grounded in objective metrics, with closed-loop tracking of prior actions and SMART next actions

skills.name: Self Review
skills.description: Audit of what the agent did, what failed, and what to improve

skills.name: Shiplog
skills.description: Recap of everything shipped since the last run - cross-repo PRs, security fixes, star deltas, and X traction, synthesized into a digest article and a ready-to-post shiplog in your voice.

skills.name: Skill Adoption
skills.description: Fleet skill-adoption leaderboard — per-slug count of how many POWER+ACTIVE forks have each upstream skill enabled, top-15 most-adopted and bottom-15 least-adopted by fleet penetration, silent when nothing moves

skills.name: Skill Gap
skills.description: Cross-fork skill adoption digest — per-fork table of upstream skills the fork hasn't enabled, top forks by gap size called out, silent when gaps are small

skills.name: skill-leaderboard
skills.description: Ranking of which skills are most popular across CONFIGURED Aeon forks (excludes untouched templates)

skills.name: soul-builder
skills.description: Build a SOUL from an X handle - read a wide sample of a public X account, then draft SOUL.md (identity, worldview, opinions), STYLE.md (voice), and examples so every skill speaks in that voice.

skills.name: Spawn Instance
skills.description: Clone this Aeon agent into a new GitHub repo - fork, configure skills, validate, and register in the fleet

skills.name: Spend Monitor
skills.description: API spend watchdog — checks running cost against the configured weekly budget cap, alerts when approaching or exceeding it

skills.name: strategy-builder
skills.description: Draft STRATEGY.md from a goal - read the operator's brief (goal, repo, links) plus the repo README and memory, then write a tight north-star/priorities/audience/constraints strategy.

packs.name: Evolution
packs.description: The self-improvement loop that makes Aeon more than a cron job: it authors and evolves new skills, installs community ones, and heals its own fleet.

skills.name: Atrium Watch
skills.description: Diff of the Atrium marketplace catalog at https://atriumhermes.tech/.well-known/skills/index.json against the prior snapshot — surfaces newly-published skills, removed skills, and updated descriptions. Supply-side complement to sparkleware-catalog (curated skill-packs.json registry) and skill-update (version drift of installed skills).

skills.name: Autoresearch
skills.description: Evolve a skill by generating variations, evaluating them, and updating the best version

skills.name: capabilities-map
skills.description: Read-only audit of installed skills' capability coverage — maps every enabled/disabled skill against the locked 6-value taxonomy in docs/CAPABILITIES.md, flags any capability tier with zero enabled coverage as an actionable gap

skills.name: capabilities-sweep
skills.description: One-shot Phase 2 sweep — infers a `capabilities:` declaration for every skill that doesn't have one yet by pattern-matching its SKILL.md body against the locked taxonomy, writes a JSON proposal manifest, and opens a single PR adding the declarations. Reruns safely (skills already declared are skipped). Closes the ~174-skill undeclared backlog left after the Phase 1 high-blast-radius sweep (PR #322).

skills.name: Create Skill
skills.description: Generate a complete new skill from a one-line prompt and ship it as a PR

skills.name: Install Skill
skills.description: Install a community skill pack into this fork from a GitHub repo and ship it as an auto-merged PR

skills.name: Phylax Audit
skills.description: Pre-install security verdict for an external agent skill before you ./add-skill it. Scans the remote SKILL.md for prompt-injection and secret-exfil, audits any Base contracts it references, and probes its x402 endpoints — then returns one deterministic ALLOW / WARN / DENY with evidence. Keyless via Base RPC + Etherscan v2.

skills.name: Search Skills
skills.description: Search the open agent skills ecosystem for skills that fill a real gap and install them via the native add-skill path

skills.name: self-improve
skills.description: Improve the agent itself, or audit its recent performance - better skills, prompts, workflows, and config, plus a quality/reliability/memory-hygiene review of what it did and what failed

skills.name: signal-verdict
skills.description: Accountability check on a configured set of tracker skills. Verifies each tracker is producing citable signals in output/articles/newsletters. Surfaces uncited trackers so the operator can demote or kill them.

skills.name: skill-enabler
skills.description: Flip enabled:false → enabled:true for a comma-separated list of skill slugs in aeon.yml — validate against skills/, fail loudly on already-enabled or missing slugs, commit, open a PR with per-skill rationale

skills.name: Skill Evals
skills.description: Validate skill outputs against assertions, diff vs prior eval to flag regressions, file issues for new failures, and queue concrete fixes

skills.name: skill-freshness
skills.description: Audit every enabled skill's upstream file dependencies for staleness — flags chained skills about to consume yesterday's article or a long-dead topic file

skills.name: Skill Dependency Graph
skills.description: Generate a navigable Mermaid dependency map of all skills with change detection, per-category drill-downs, and enabled overlay

skills.name: Skill Health
skills.description: Fleet skill observability with two views - health audits per-skill metrics and files/resolves issues in memory/issues/; analytics ranks the fleet by 7d runs, success rates, and anomaly flags.

skills.name: Skill Repair
skills.description: Diagnose and fix failing or degraded skills automatically - systemic-first triage, per-category playbooks, and a verification plan

skills.name: Skill Scan
skills.description: Audit skills, workflows, and companion scripts for injection, exfiltration, traversal, and prompt-override risks with delta tracking, baseline suppression, issue filing, and per-finding remediation

skills.name: Skill Triage
skills.description: Structured triage for inbound PRs that introduce or modify SKILL.md files — security scan per skill, required-secrets enumeration, cron slot-conflict check, basic quality signals, posted as one PR comment. The receipt that turns a 10-minute manual skill-PR review into a 10-second human decision

skills.name: Skill Update
skills.description: Check imported skills for upstream changes and security regressions since the version in skills.lock

skills.name: sparkleware-catalog
skills.description: Enriched export of skill-packs.json — joins the canonical community registry to live GitHub signals (stars, last-push, live manifest skill count) and writes a machine-readable skill-packs-catalog.json that external tools (e.g. Sparkleware) can consume without screen-scraping

skills.name: Tool Builder
skills.description: Build automation scripts from action-converter suggestions and recurring manual tasks

packs.name: Basics
packs.description: Simple, immediately-runnable skills - point them at a topic, repo, token, or tx and get a useful result with little or no setup.

skills.name: Action Converter
skills.description: 5 concrete real-life actions, leverage-scored against open loops with specificity and anti-fluff gates

skills.name: agent-displacement
skills.description: Tracker of AI agent substitution signals — which roles, companies, and industries show real headcount displacement. Named roles + real deployments only.

skills.name: Article
skills.description: Write a publication-ready article in one of three angles - a trending long-form piece, a watched-repo thesis, or a project-through-a-lens essay. Optional Replicate hero image with --visual.

skills.name: BD Radar
skills.description: Business-development radar across your product family - find who's building, forking, integrating, and mentioning your products, ranked into a who-to-talk-to-this-week lead list.

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.description: Exhaustive multi-source synthesis on any topic with explicit source credibility tiering and per-finding confidence — analyst-grade, not aggregator-grade

skills.name: Digest
skills.description: Generate and send a digest on a configurable topic, optionally pulling RSS/Atom feeds as an input source alongside web + X signal

skills.name: Farcaster Digest
skills.description: Clustered, signal-scored digest of Farcaster casts with conversation-shape lead and insight-first editorial notes

skills.name: Fetch Tweets
skills.description: Search and curate X/Twitter behind one selector - keyword, topic roundup, a single or tracked-account digest, an X list, or the AI-agent buzz preset - clustered into signal-scored sub-narratives.

skills.name: GitHub Trending
skills.description: Curated trending across GitHub repos and the Hugging Face Hub (models, datasets, spaces) - filtered, clustered, and labeled by momentum with a one-line why-notable per pick.

skills.name: HN Digest
skills.description: Top HN stories filtered by interests, with comment-mined insights and themed clustering

skills.name: Hugging Face Trending
skills.description: Curated trending Hugging Face models, datasets, and spaces — filtered, clustered, and labeled with a "why notable" line per pick

skills.name: Idea Forge
skills.description: Three-mode idea engine - generate collides the week's zeitgeist with what you can ship into scored wedges; validate viability-screens the idea backlog; memo writes evidence-backed startup memos.

skills.name: Last 30 Days
skills.description: Cross-platform social research - narrative-first intelligence on what people are saying about a topic across Reddit, X, HN, Polymarket, and the web over the last 30 days

skills.name: mcp-pulse
skills.description: Tracker for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem — new server implementations, adoption velocity, npm/GitHub signals, and protocol evolution. Thesis check — is MCP becoming the default tool-call rail for agents?

skills.name: Paper Digest
skills.description: Find and summarize new papers matching tracked research interests

skills.name: Paper Pick
skills.description: Find the one paper most worth reading from Hugging Face Papers

skills.name: PR Review
skills.description: Review open PRs two ways - default is a per-PR deep review with severity-tagged findings, inline comments, and a verdict; --survey runs a risk-tiered triage digest of what's safe to merge first

skills.name: Price Alert
skills.description: Fire when the tracked token does something - new ATH, sharp 1h move, or operator-set target crossed. Silent on normal days.

skills.name: Reddit Digest
skills.description: Detect cross-subreddit narratives — stories surfacing in multiple unrelated subs at once

skills.name: Research Brief
skills.description: Deep dive on a topic with a falsifiable thesis, cited claims, and explicit uncertainty

skills.name: RSS Feed Generator
skills.description: Generate an Atom XML feed from articles, validate it, and notify only when it actually changes

skills.name: Telegram Digest
skills.description: Cross-channel digest of public Telegram posts — ranked by signal, clustered by narrative, not by channel

skills.name: Token Movers
skills.description: Crypto market scanner and single-token analyst - movers scans top winners/losers/trending or on-chain runners with pump-risk flags; single-token produces a verdict-first deep report for one token.

skills.name: Tx Explain
skills.description: Decode any Base transaction into a plain-English story - method, token movements, swaps/approvals, counterparties, and suspicious-approval flags. Keyless via Base RPC + Etherscan v2.

skills.name: Vibecoding Digest
skills.description: Decision-ready pulse of r/vibecoding — ranked by signal score, narrative-clustered, with a one-line verdict and tools leaderboard

skills.name: Wallet Digest
skills.description: Lightweight balance-and-activity summary across tracked wallets. Sibling to onchain-monitor — balances-only, no per-transfer decode.

skills.name: Write Tweet
skills.description: Multi-format tweet studio - standalone drafts (10 across 5 size tiers), a 5-10 tweet thread, or 10 remixes of past tweets, selected via ${var}

packs.name: Dev & Code
packs.description: GitHub and repo automation: PR/issue triage, review, merges, releases, changelogs, repo health, security scanning, and app deploys.

skills.name: builder-map
skills.description: Map of who's building on top of watched repos — forks, third-party ecosystem repos, builder announcements. Answers the "who's building on top" question.

skills.name: Changelog
skills.description: Generate a user-facing changelog from recent commits/PRs across watched repos - write it in-repo (Keep a Changelog format) or open a cross-repo changelog PR on a docs/marketing repo.

skills.name: Code Health
skills.description: Report on TODOs, dead code, and test coverage gaps

skills.name: Deploy Prototype
skills.description: Generate a small app or tool and deploy it live to Vercel via API

skills.name: Disclosure Emailer
skills.description: Auto-send staged out-of-band vulnerability disclosures by email (via Resend, in-run) when PVR is disabled and there is no public-PR channel — the last safe disclosure path for code flaws

skills.name: disclosure-tracker
skills.description: Audit of the pending vulnerability disclosure queue — tracks draft advisories in memory/pending-disclosures/, alerts on aging CRITICAL/HIGH findings.

skills.name: Docs Sync
skills.description: Sync recently merged product PRs into the marketing website as a changelog — opens a PR on the website repo

skills.name: ecosystem-links
skills.description: Link-health audit of ECOSYSTEM.md — checks every GitHub repo for archived/disabled state and every project URL for HTTP 4xx/5xx or redirect chains, surfacing dead/archived/moved entries before a casual reader stumbles into one. Closes the three-skill ecosystem loop with ecosystem-entrants (arrivals) and ecosystem-pulse (liveness).

skills.name: ecosystem-pulse
skills.description: Liveness check of the projects listed in ECOSYSTEM.md — stars/forks/last-commit recency + new releases for any project that can be matched to a GitHub repo

skills.name: External Feature
skills.description: Proactively enhance watched repos — fix issues, add features, improve code

skills.name: Feature
skills.description: Build, enhance, or revive GitHub repos - ship one feature PR per watched repo (watched), make the best single enhancement on one external repo (external), or revive the top dormant repo (dormant).

skills.name: GitHub Issues
skills.description: Digest of new open issues across your repos, ranked by signal (security/bug/feature/other)

skills.name: GitHub Monitor
skills.description: Watch your GitHub repos across four views - a combined urgency monitor (stale PRs, new issues, releases), a new-issue triage queue, a release upgrade digest, or your own opened-PR tracker.

skills.name: GitHub Releases
skills.description: Upgrade-triage digest of new releases across watched AI/infra/crypto repos

skills.name: Inbox Triage
skills.description: Daily GitHub notification inbox triage - surfaces aging vuln PR replies, security advisories, review requests, and mentions that need action

skills.name: Issue Triage
skills.description: Decision-ready triage — classify, dedupe, and emit a verdict + next action per new GitHub issue

skills.name: PR Tracker
skills.description: Track status of cross-repo PRs opened by this aeon instance — merges, stale open, and closures

skills.name: PR Triage
skills.description: First-touch triage for external pull requests - verdict, label, and a welcoming comment within minutes of open

skills.name: PVR Triage
skills.description: Lifecycle check on submitted private vulnerability reports — polls triage state, detects maintainer acceptance or rejection, surfaces action items when PVRs age past 30 days with no response

skills.name: pvr-watchlist
skills.description: Probe of repos on the security watchlist — check if private vulnerability reporting has been enabled, notify when status flips, re-submit any queued advisories or flag for re-research when draft was lost

skills.name: repo-actions
skills.description: Generate 5 anchored, implementable action ideas for a watched repo — specificity-gated, priority-ranked, with a Top Pick verdict

skills.name: repo-pulse
skills.description: Report on new stars, forks, and releases for watched repos — with notable-stargazer enrichment and a one-line growth verdict

skills.name: Repo Revive
skills.description: Pick the highest-★ dormant watched repo and make one targeted improvement to reactivate it — refresh stale model references, README, or metadata

skills.name: Repo Scanner
skills.description: Catalog GitHub repos into a prioritized fleet report with concrete, coded opportunities that downstream skills consume directly

skills.name: Security Digest
skills.description: Lead with confirmed exploitation (CISA KEV), enrich with EPSS, filter GitHub Advisories to your tracked stack, output one action per item

skills.name: Vercel Projects
skills.description: Triage Vercel deploy fleet — verdict, errored-first, what-changed since last snapshot

skills.name: Vuln Scanner
skills.description: Audit trending repos for real security vulnerabilities and disclose responsibly - scan and route findings (PVR / dependency PR), re-submit queued advisories, and send armed email disclosures

skills.name: Vuln Tracker
skills.description: One lifecycle poll over everything vuln-scanner produces - PR and advisory status, PVR triage transitions, and pending-disclosure aging, with a stars-secured impact headline and one action queue.

skills.name: Workflow Audit
skills.description: Audit .github/workflows and composite actions with zizmor + actionlint, classify findings against the prior audit, auto-fix Critical/High regressions, and open a PR only when something actually changed.

packs.name: Crypto & Markets
packs.description: Token, DeFi, and prediction-market monitoring plus on-chain investigation and action: alerts, narrative tracking, market context, and token forensics.

skills.name: AIXBT Pulse
skills.description: Cross-domain market pulse from AIXBT's free grounding endpoint — crypto, macro, tradfi, geopolitics. Refreshes taxonomy references (clusters, chains) as a bonus.

skills.name: Approval Audit
skills.description: List a wallet's live ERC-20 token approvals on Base and flag unlimited / risky spender grants. Keyless via Base RPC (eth_getLogs + eth_call) — no explorer key needed.

skills.name: Base MCP
skills.description: Access a Base Account via the Base MCP server (mcp.base.org) - wallet, portfolio, sending, swapping, signing, x402 payments, batched calls, and transaction history.

skills.name: BEAMR Route
skills.description: Route a prompt through a BEAMR x402 gateway and report the answer + onchain receipt

skills.name: compute-pulse
skills.description: Tracker for the AI compute market — GPU/hardware deals, inference pricing trends, decentralized compute token signals, and lab vs hyperscaler dynamics.

skills.name: CTRL
skills.description: Build on-chain automation on Base via CTRL - DCA, price-gated swaps, launchpad sniping, or whale-follow that run autonomously after one EIP-5792 wallet signature, bounded by preset caps.

skills.name: DeFi Overview
skills.description: One-pass crypto read - tracked-protocol positions and health plus macro context, with regime take, DeFi verdict, biggest movers, yields, fees, breadth, Fear & Greed, and prediction markets.

skills.name: Distribute Tokens
skills.description: Two-phase contributor rewards - plan builds a tier-priced payout from the repo's merged-PR ranking; send executes it on-chain via Bankr Wallet API with per-recipient idempotency and dry-run.

skills.name: Fear Divergence
skills.description: Conditional scan — fires only when Fear & Greed < 25. Identifies assets outperforming during broad market fear, synthesizes narrative catalysts from memory, and delivers a terse conviction setup brief. Skips silently when market conditions don't qualify.

skills.name: Fund Flow
skills.description: Trace where funds move to (or came from) across multiple hops from a Base address and render a Mermaid flow graph. Keyless — no explorer key needed.

skills.name: Investigation Report
skills.description: One-shot Base-token investigation - runs any subset of six onchain-security checks (rug-scan, contract-audit, deployer-trace, holder-concentration, honeypot, lp-lock) into one verdict. Keyless core.

skills.name: Linked Wallets
skills.description: Cluster addresses likely controlled by the same entity on Base via shared-funder and co-spend heuristics. Keyless — no explorer key needed.

skills.name: LiquidPad Launch
skills.description: Deploy a LiquidPad token on Base in-run via its public API. Routes 80% fees to deployer, 15% to LPAD burn, 5% to LIQ buyback, contract-enforced.

skills.name: Monitor Kalshi
skills.description: Monitor specific Kalshi prediction markets for 24h price moves, volume changes, and top events

skills.name: Monitor Prediction Markets
skills.description: Monitor Polymarket and/or Kalshi prediction markets for 24h price moves, volume changes, fresh comments, and high-conviction alerts

skills.name: Narrative Tracker
skills.description: Track rising, peaking, and fading crypto/tech narratives with quantitative mindshare + velocity signals and explicit positioning calls

skills.name: Onchain Monitor
skills.description: Monitor blockchain addresses and contracts for notable activity

skills.name: Picks Tracker
skills.description: Retrospective on past token and prediction market picks - what hit, what flopped, what the score is

skills.name: PM Manipulation
skills.description: Detect suspected manipulation on prediction markets over the past 3 days by cross-referencing price/volume/comment anomalies with multilingual local-press coverage

skills.name: pm-pulse
skills.description: Prediction-market & coordination-market tracker — volume on tracked platforms, new mechanism designs, reflexive market launches, regulatory moves

skills.name: Regulatory Monitor
skills.description: Track legislation, regulatory actions, and legal developments affecting prediction markets, crypto, and AI agents — triaged by stage × impact for decision-ready output

skills.name: rwa-pulse
skills.description: Real World Asset tokenization momentum tracker — surfaces new protocol launches, TVL milestones, institutional adoption, and regulatory approvals

skills.name: Token Pick
skills.description: One token recommendation and one prediction market pick - scored, quantified, with a skip branch when signals are weak

skills.name: Treasury Info
skills.description: Decision-ready treasury overview — verdict, concentration, depegs, significant changes

skills.name: Unlock Monitor
skills.description: Token unlock and vesting tracker - quantify supply pressure via absorption ratio, classify cliff vs linear, and deliver one-line market reads

skills.name: VIGIL Security Scanner
skills.description: Onchain security scanner on Base — scan token approvals, detect honeypots, analyze contracts for rugpull indicators, and score contract safety. Keyless read-only scanning via VIGIL API. Revoke actions require Bankr auth and are gated separately.

skills.name: VIGIL Approval Revoker
skills.description: Revoke a single live ERC-20 approval on Base via Bankr. Confirms the approval is live, then submits `approve(spender, 0)` and waits for receipt. workflow_dispatch only — `var` is the `wallet:spender:token` triplet returned by VIGIL / approval-audit / wallet-risk. Closes the detection→revoke loop that VIGIL PR #323 explicitly split out.

skills.name: Wallet Profile
skills.description: Behavioral profile of any wallet on Base — age, activity class (bot/whale/sniper/trader), funding source, top counterparties, and risk flags. Keyless via Etherscan v2 + Base RPC.

skills.name: Wallet Risk
skills.description: Risk audit of this agent's own Base wallets — live ERC-20 approvals (unlimited flagged), honeypot simulation on every token with a live approval, severity-tiered findings. Keyless via Base RPC. First scheduled consumer of the HoundFlow security pack against `.x402books/wallets.json`.

skills.name: Protocol Monitor (x402 default)
skills.description: Tracker for a configured protocol's ecosystem velocity — new GitHub integrations, npm adoption, notable announcements. Defaults to x402; operators swap in their own protocol via memory/topics/tracked-protocol.md.

packs.name: Productivity
packs.description: Personal + social ops: routines, idea capture, retrospectives, deal flow, mentions, replies, ads, email, and knowledge housekeeping.

skills.name: article-queue
skills.description: Article idea synthesizer — ranks signals from topic-momentum, beat-tracker, and narrative-tracker into a prioritized queue the article skill reads on its next run

skills.name: beat-tracker
skills.description: Multi-beat news thread tracker — persists beat counts per active storyline, searches for new developments, alerts when a thread hits the article-ready threshold (3rd beat)

skills.name: Channel Recap
skills.description: Recap article from a public Telegram channel — rank posts by engagement, expand on the best

skills.name: Competitor Radar
skills.description: Scan of Product Hunt + Hacker News for NEW AI-agent-framework launches outside the 9-framework cohort already tracked by framework-watch

skills.name: content-performance
skills.description: Operator tweet performance tracker — engagement metrics, top formats, topic resonance; closes the content feedback loop in the article/tweet production pipeline

skills.name: Create Campaign
skills.description: Provision Meta campaigns and ad sets on AdManage.ai from a declarative config. Runs on-demand — creates entities PAUSED in-run, writes the returned IDs back into state so schedule-ads can launch into them.

skills.name: Deal Flow
skills.description: Funding round tracker across configurable verticals

skills.name: Engagement Act
skills.description: Turn flagged engagement opportunities into ready-to-post replies — read recent logs, draft specific responses, send as copy-paste-ready output

skills.name: Framework Watch
skills.description: Competitive-intelligence digest on the AI agent framework space — momentum, releases, breaking changes across a curated watchlist

skills.name: Goal Tracker
skills.description: Compare current progress against goals with quantified status, velocity, trend, and a concrete next action per goal

skills.name: Idea Capture
